name: Studio Nterio
description: Studio Nterio is a Mumbai-based interior design studio specialising in turnkey home renovations, modular kitchens, and luxury interiors. Led by principal designer Namit, we design homes for real life — not showrooms. Our projects span 2BHK to 4BHK apartments across Andheri, Bandra, Powai, BKC, Thane, and Lonavala. From space planning to final styling, we handle the complete process so you don't have to manage contractors alone. If you're renovating your home and want a studio that's honest, detail-obsessed, and delivers on time — let's talk.

owner_posts.post_text:
Q: How do I start working with Studio Nterio?
A: Reach out via our website at studionterio.com or call us directly. We start with a free 30-minute consultation to understand your space, timeline, and budget.

Q: What areas of Mumbai do you cover?
A: We work across Andheri, Bandra, Juhu, Powai, BKC, Lower Parel, Worli, Thane, and Navi Mumbai. We also take select projects in Lonavala and Pune.

Q: What does a turnkey renovation include?
